units.source_text: 同一种香剂调制法，广泛流传各处。

en.t: The same method for blending incense had spread widely everywhere.

units.source_text: 但因人人趣味不同，配合分量略异，因而香气浓淡各别。

en.t: But because each person had different tastes and varied the proportions slightly, the strength and delicacy of the fragrance differed from one blend to another.

units.source_text: 此种研究分析，非常饶有趣味。

en.t: This kind of study and comparison was extremely interesting.

units.source_text: 萤兵部卿亲王觉得各种香剂互有短长，难于断然评定。

en.t: Prince Hotaru, the Minister of War, felt that each incense had its own merits and faults, making it hard to give a decisive judgment.

units.source_text: 其中只有前斋院槿姬送来的“黑方”，毕竟幽雅沉静，与众不同。

en.t: Among them, only the Black Formula sent by Princess Asagao, the former Saiin, was after all quiet, elegant, and unlike the rest.

units.source_text: 至于“侍从”，则确定源氏所制者最为优良，香气文雅可爱。

en.t: As for the Attendant blend, it was decided that Genji's version was the finest, with a refined and charming fragrance.

units.source_text: 紫姬所制的三种香剂之中，“梅花”的气味爽朗而新鲜，配方分量稍强，故有一种珍奇的香气。

en.t: Among the three incenses made by Lady Murasaki, Plum Blossom smelled bright and fresh, and because its formula was a little stronger, it had a rare and unusual fragrance.

units.source_text: 萤兵部卿亲王赞道：“在这梅花盛开的季节，风里飘来的香气，恐怕也不能胜过这种香剂吧。”

en.t: Prince Hotaru praised it, saying, In this season when the plum blossoms are in full bloom, even the scent drifting on the wind could probably not surpass this incense.

units.source_text: 住在夏殿里的花散里，闻知各位夫人大家制香，互相竞赛，觉得自己何必挤在里头，与人争长。

en.t: Lady Hanachirusato, who lived in the summer residence, heard that all the ladies were making incense and competing with one another, and felt there was no need for her to force herself into the contest and vie with them.

units.source_text: 可见她在制香等事情上也是谦虚退让的。

en.t: This shows that even in matters such as incense making, she was modest and willing to step back.

units.source_text: 因此她所制的只有一种夏季用的“荷叶”，香气特别幽静，异常芬芳可爱。

en.t: For that reason, she made only one summer incense, Lotus Leaf, whose scent was especially quiet and secluded, extraordinarily fragrant and lovely.

units.source_text: 住在冬殿里的明石姬，本想调制一种冬季用的“落叶”，

en.t: Lady Akashi, who lived in the winter residence, had at first intended to blend a winter incense called Fallen Leaves,

units.source_text: 但念此香比不上别人，亦甚乏味。

en.t: but she thought that this incense would not compare with the others and would also be rather dull.

units.source_text: 因此想起：从前宇多天皇有一种优越的熏衣香调制法，

en.t: So she remembered that long ago Emperor Uda had possessed an excellent formula for perfuming robes,

units.source_text: 公忠朝臣得其秘传，

en.t: and that the courtier Kintada had received its secret transmission,

units.source_text: 再加研究精选，制成名香“百步”。

en.t: then refined and selected the ingredients further to create the famous incense Hundred Paces.

units.source_text: 她便依照此方调制，香气馥郁，异乎寻常。

en.t: She therefore blended her incense according to this formula, and its fragrance was rich, full, and altogether extraordinary.

units.source_text: 萤兵部卿亲王认为此人心工最为巧妙。

en.t: Prince Hotaru thought that her taste and craftsmanship were the most skillful of all.

units.source_text: 照他的评判，各人各有优点。

en.t: According to his judgment, each person had her own particular strengths.

units.source_text: 因此源氏讥笑他道：“你这评判者真是面面光的啊！”

en.t: So Genji teased him, saying, What a wonderfully even-handed judge you are, pleasing everyone on all sides!
